request.description: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful. Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it. Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right. Class: one small clump of trees for a strategy map: three to five trees standing close together as one free-standing cut-out, calmer and less saturated than units, simple shapes, no face. It stands on the empty transparent background with nothing drawn under it: no ground, no grass, no soil. Subject: a jungle clump: two leaning palm trees, one squat cycad and giant fern fronds; lush deep greens (#2f7d45, #4fa55a) with yellow-green highlights and brown ringed trunks; the outline is a dark green tone, never pure black. Must not include: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject, ground plate, platform, grass square, soil patch, slab, background, buildings, people.
